w.lore: MANUK developed a chilling, emotionless stare when threatened by older orphans, ready to carve their name into the annals of history with steel.

injuries.name: Dislocated Shoulder
injuries.description: Arm can barely hold a weapon.

injuries.name: Broken Arm
injuries.description: Arm in a sling. Fighting ability devastated.

w.name: HEROAHARD
w.origin: Raised by the blind beggar-priests of the Sunken Cathedral
w.lore: HEROAHARD flogged daily until they learned how to absorb the pain without flinching, until they tore the iron collar from a taskmaster’s throat and claimed their true name.

w.name: JISH
w.lore: JISH developed an iron grip from clinging to the underside of merchant carts, looking for the one fight that will finally set them free.
w.origin: Raised by debt-collectors in the squalor of the Brass District

w.name: GRIFFON
w.origin: Raised by the strict matrons of the Sisters of Mercy Orphanage
w.lore: GRIFFON would silently endure beatings to learn how to absorb blows, knowing that the iron portcullis of the arena was the only true gate to freedom.

injuries.name: Deep Laceration
injuries.description: A wound that weakens with every movement.

w.name: ICEHEART
w.origin: Grew up fighting for scraps in the sunken ruins of the Drowned Ward Orphanage
w.lore: ICEHEART never flinched when the master raised a hand, until they shattered their first blade on an oppressor's skull, realizing their bare hands were deadlier.

injuries.name: Deep Laceration

w.name: ZYNYTHYFANG
w.origin: Surviving on rats and rain in the crumbling attic of the Sisters of Mercy
w.lore: ZYNYTHYFANG learned to map out exit routes the moment they entered a new room, until they drowned a corrupt overseer in a vat of boiling lye.

injuries.name: Broken Arm
injuries.description: Arm in a sling. Fighting ability devastated.

w.name: SHAESYVEIL
w.origin: Survived the chilling cullings of the Whispering Vaults
w.lore: SHAESYVEIL would deliberately stand in the freezing rain for hours to test their resolve, until they strangled a veteran gladiator with their bare hands in a tavern brawl.

w.name: FENGATH
w.origin: Raised in the sunless basements of the Hollow Hill Orphanage
w.lore: FENGATH developed calluses like iron from constantly punching the stone walls of their cell, knowing that the only way to escape the slums was to build a staircase of bones.

w.name: NANUR
w.origin: Endured the starvation diets of the Hollow Creek Workhouse
w.lore: NANUR mastered the art of reading micro-expressions from surviving the brutal politics of the beggar king, realizing the arena was the only place where their rage was rewarded with silver.

w.name: CROHARD
w.origin: Endured the starvation diets of the Hollow Creek Workhouse
w.lore: CROHARD learned to sleep with a clenched fist and one eye open, knowing that the deafening roar of the bloodsands could silence the screaming ghosts of their past.

w.name: RAVENMOOR
w.origin: Forged in the merciless fires of the Cinder-Ash Orphanage
w.lore: RAVENMOOR was known to stare unblinking at the flickering flames of the hearth, discovering that the roar of the arena crowd could drown out their dark memories.

w.name: RASKUKYNN
w.origin: Found wandering the ash-choked plains with no memory of their name
w.lore: RASKUKYNN would silently trace the weak points on sleeping guards, now seeking vengeance on the system that abandoned them.

w.name: VEL
w.origin: Born during the red comet, abandoned to the howling winds
w.lore: VEL developed a haunting stare that made even the guards look away, knowing that only the roar of the colosseum could silence the screams of their past.

w.name: GORHALG
w.origin: Abandoned during the chaotic riots of the Lower Wards
w.lore: GORHALG was known for collecting the teeth of feral dogs slain in the alleys, fueled by a hatred of the weakness that once kept them in chains.

w.name: GAWEALOAK
w.origin: Raised in the submerged basements of the Drowned Wards
w.lore: GAWEALOAK always hid a sharpened stone in their cheek, now standing at the threshold of a legacy they are eager to claim.

w.name: VAHARD
w.origin: Sold to the fighting pits by the matrons of the Bleak House
w.lore: VAHARD learned to fashion razor-sharp shivs from the rusted iron rungs of their crib, carrying a burning need to leave a scar upon the world that rejected them.

w.name: GACASON
w.origin: Survived the merciless frostbite cullings of the Weeping Stone Slums
w.lore: GACASON developed a chilling, emotionless stare when threatened by older orphans, with nothing left to lose and everything to bleed for.

w.name: QUUFLISENAEANUS
w.origin: Born in the shadow of the Obsidian Spire to a family of soot-gatherers
w.lore: QUUFLISENAEANUS would silently endure beatings to learn how to absorb blows, realizing the arena was the only place where their rage was rewarded with silver.

w.name: KHEZES
w.origin: Left as an infant in a weapons crate outside the barracks
w.lore: KHEZES showed a terrifyingly high tolerance for pain during beatings, until they drove a splintered chair leg through a slaver.

w.name: VRIZUPH
w.origin: Raised in the sunless depths of the Weeping Undercroft
w.lore: VRIZUPH learned to wield a shattered bottle neck with terrifying, lethal precision, until they strangled an abusive warden and stepped into the light.

w.name: SYRAH
w.origin: Abandoned at the iron grates of the Silent Brothers
w.lore: SYRAH was known for biting viciously when cornered by older urchins, realizing that mercy in the undercity is just an invitation for an early grave.

w.name: QUORIS
w.origin: Pulled from the churning waters of the Weeping Gorge as a toddler
w.lore: QUORIS was caught repeatedly catching scorpions with their bare hands, until they watched their only friend die for a handful of copper coins.

w.name: THALIA
w.origin: Survived the great fire that consumed the Iron Spire Orphanage
w.lore: THALIA flogged daily until they learned how to absorb the pain without flinching, knowing that the roar of the crowd was the only lullaby they ever needed.

w.name: IVAR
w.origin: Abandoned to the howling winds of the Jagged Peaks, raised by a solitary hermit
w.lore: IVAR would compulsively trace the veins of slaughtered livestock to learn anatomy, carrying the weight of their past with a grim, unyielding determination.

w.name: YAHYTH
w.origin: Sole survivor of a workhouse fire in the lower slums
w.lore: YAHYTH would catch and study the weak points of venomous centipedes, realizing that the blood-soaked sands were the only true home for the forgotten.
